mapper.select: select rule_code as ruleCode, rule_name as ruleName, prefix as prefix, date_format as dateFormat, serial_length as serialLength, serial_start as serialStart, serial_step as serialStep, reset_cycle as resetCycle, enable_flag as enableFlag from sys_code_rule where rule_code = #{ruleCode} limit 1
select count(*) from sys_code_reservation where document_code = #{code}
mapper.insert: insert into sys_code_sequence (rule_code, period_key, current_no) values (#{ruleCode}, #{periodKey}, last_insert_id(#{startNo})) on duplicate key update current_no = last_insert_id(current_no + #{step})
mapper.select: select distinct cast(substring(t.code, #{serialPos}) as unsigned) as seq from ( select case -- 链号子序号（如 zj2026112100004-01）：去掉尾部 -NN 后按链号取流水 when instr(${columnName}, '-') > 0 and substring_index(${columnName}, '-', -1) regexp '^[0-9]{2}$' then substring_index(${columnName}, '-', 1) -- 报工号（如 gd2026112100004-bg009）：取最后一段 when instr(${columnName}, '-') > 0 then substring_index(${columnName}, '-', -1) else ${columnName} end as code from ${tableName} ) t where t.code like concat(#{codePrefix}, '%')
